out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. MOUSE DROPPINGS WERE FOUND IN MULTIPLE AREAS OF THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE CONTACT THE PEST CONTROL COMPANY FACILITY USES AND HAVE THEM COMPLETE TREATMENT UNTIL MICE AND MICE DROPPINGS AFE GONE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO HANDWASHING SINK AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: NAPKINS WERE PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC UNABLE TO SUPPLY EMPLOYEE HEALTH FORMS.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS EMAILED EMPLOYEE HEALTH FORMS TO PIC TO FILL OUT.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PIC PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS FOR THE HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HOT WATER AT HANDWASHING SINKS (~70F).
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. HANDWASHING SINKS MUST BE ABLE TO PRODUCE 100F WATER AT ALL TIMES SO THAT EMPLOYEES MAY WASH THEIR HANDS. MELOS RESTAURANT & LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 06/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. -OBSERVED COCKROACH NEAR CHEST FREEZER ON WALL. -OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE NUMBER OF SMALL FLIES NEAR DRAINS BEHIND BAR AND IN KITCHEN
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PEST CONTROL MUST COME WITHIN 10 DAYS, AND EHS MUST BE PROVIDED WITH INVOICE FOR DOCUMENTATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED CHEST FREEZER TO BE RUSTING AND THE SEAL IS BROKEN.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CHEST FREEZER MUST BE REPLACED WITHIN 10 DAYS (JUNE 20TH).

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED WALK-IN COOLER NOT FUNCTIONING AND ACTIVELY BEING REPAIRED BECAUSE IT DOES NOT HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. WALK-IN COOLER MUST BE REPAIRED OR REPLACED TO HOLD FOOD FROM 41F OR BELOW WITHIN TEN DAYS (JUNE 20TH).

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED ~70F WATER AT 3-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. WATER AT THE 3-VAT SINK MUST BE AT LEAST 110F. THIS MUST BE IN COMPLIANCE WITHIN TEN DAYS (JUNE 20TH).

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater / boiler serving the food service establishment is no longer operable. OBSERVED WATER HEATER BROKEN AND TURNED OFF.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. At this time, a new commercial, approved water heater shall be installed to meet the peak hot water demands. The water heater shall be approved prior to installation. WATER HEATER MUST BE REPAIRED ACCORDING TO THE ABOVE SPECIFICATIONS. THIS MUST BE IN COMPLIANCE WITHIN 10 DAYS (JUNE 20TH).

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK BEHIND THE BAR TO BE HANGING OFF THE WALL AND NO DRAIN PIPE IS CONNECTED TO SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. SINK MUST BE SEALED TO THE WALL AND A PIPE MUST BE ATTACHED. SINK MUST BE REPAIRED PER LAW WITHIN TEN DAYS (JUNE 20TH).
